grammar: Subject + am not + going to + verb (future basic)
en: I am not going to be late again.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt ˈgoʊɪŋ tu bi leɪt əˈgɛn/
trPron: Ay em nat goİng tu bi leyt agen
collocations: not going to, be late again
commonMistake: I not going to be late. ❌
aiExplain: I not going yanlıştır. "I am not going" doğrudur.
imgQuery: person looking at clock with determination

en: It isn't my fault that we missed the bus.
ipa: /ɪt ˈɪzənt maɪ fɔlt ðæt wi mɪst ðə bʌs/
trPron: İt izınt may folt det vi mist dı bas
collocations: isn't my fault, missed the bus
commonMistake: It not my fault. ❌
aiExplain: It not my fault yanlıştır. "It isn't my fault" doğrudur.
imgQuery: person pointing away at bus stop

en: This phone isn't as fast as that one.
tr: Bu telefon şuradaki kadar hızlı değil.
ipa: /ðɪs foʊn ˈɪzənt æz fæst æz ðæt wʌn/
trPron: Dis fon izınt ez fast ez dat van
collocations: isn't as fast as, fast as
commonMistake: This phone isn't fast as that one. ❌
aiExplain: İsnt as fast as kalıbında ikinci "as" şarttır. "Fast as" yanlıştır.

en: I am not happy with the result.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt ˈhæpi wɪð ðə rɪˈzʌlt/
trPron: Ay em nat hepi vit dı rizalt
collocations: not happy with, happy with result
commonMistake: I am not happy from the result. ❌
aiExplain: Happy with doğru kullanımdır. "Happy from" yanlıştır.

en: You aren't allowed to park here.
ipa: /juː ɑrnt əˈlaʊd tu pɑrk hɪr/
trPron: Yu arnt ılaud tu park hir
collocations: aren't allowed to, allowed to park
commonMistake: You aren't allowed park here. ❌
aiExplain: Allowed to kalıbında "to" şarttır. "Allowed park" yanlıştır.

en: That isn't a good idea.
ipa: /ðæt ˈɪzənt ə gʊd aɪˈdiə/
trPron: Det izınt ı gud aydi 98
collocations: isn't a good idea, good idea
commonMistake: Low
aiExplain: That not a good idea yanlıştır. "That isn't a good idea" doğrudur.

en: I am not sure if this is correct.
tr: Bunun doğru olup olmadığından emin değilim.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt ʃʊr ɪf ðɪs ɪz kəˈrɛkt/
trPron: Ay em nat şur if dis iz korekt
collocations: not sure if, am not sure
commonMistake: I not sure if this correct. ❌
aiExplain: I not sure ve "this correct" ikisi de yanlıştır. Her iki cümlede de be fiili gerekir.

en: It isn't necessary to bring a gift.
ipa: /ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈnɛsəˌsɛri tu brɪŋ ə gɪft/
trPron: İt izınt nesıseri tu bring ı gift
collocations: isn't necessary to, necessary to
commonMistake: It isn't necessary bring a gift. ❌
aiExplain: It isn't necessary bring yanlıştır. "To bring" mastarı gerekir.

en: It isn't possible to finish today.
ipa: /ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈpɑsəbəl tu ˈfɪnɪʃ təˈdeɪ/
trPron: İt izınt pasıbıl tu fİnİş tudey
collocations: isn't possible to, possible to
commonMistake: It isn't possible finish today. ❌
aiExplain: It isn't possible finish yanlıştır. "To finish" mastarı gerekir.
imgQuery: person looking at large pile of work

en: These shoes aren't expensive.
ipa: /ðiz ʃuz ɑrnt ɪkˈspɛnsɪv/
trPron: Diz şuz arnt ikspensiv
collocations: aren't expensive, not expensive
commonMistake: These shoes isn't expensive. ❌
aiExplain: Shoes çoğul olduğu için "isn't" değil "aren't" kullanılır.

grammar: Subject + am not + afraid of + noun
en: I am not afraid of dogs.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt əˈfreɪd əv dɔgz/
trPron: Ay em nat ıfreyd ov dogz
collocations: not afraid of, afraid of
commonMistake: I am not afraid from dogs. ❌ (Türk hatası)
aiExplain: Afraid from yanlıştır. Doğrusu "afraid of"dur. person petting a dog

grammar: Subject + am not + related to + noun
en: I am not related to him.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt rɪˈleɪtɪd tu hɪm/
trPron: Ay em nat rileytıd tu him
collocations: not related to, related to
commonMistake: I am not related with him. ❌
aiExplain: Related with yanlıştır. Doğrusu "related to"dur.

en: not into, into sports
ipa: keen on, fond of
trPron: not interested, bored by
collocations: Not into samimi İngilizcedir. "Not interested in" daha resmidir. İkisi de doğrudur.
commonMistake: A1

grammar: Subject + am not + sure about + noun
en: I am not sure about the date.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt ʃʊr əˈbaʊt ðə deɪt/
trPron: Ay em nat şur abaut dı deyt
collocations: not sure about, sure about
commonMistake: I am not sure the date. ❌
aiExplain: Sure den sonra "about" gelir. "Sure the date" yanlıştır.

en: I am not supposed to tell anyone.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt səˈpoʊzd tu tɛl ˈɛniˌwʌn/
trPron: Ay em nat sıpozd tu tel enivın
collocations: not supposed to, supposed to tell
commonMistake: I am not supposed tell anyone. ❌
aiExplain: Supposed to kalıbında "to" şarttır. "Supposed tell" yanlıştır.

en: This isn't like the one I saw.
ipa: /ðɪs ˈɪzənt laɪk ðə wʌn aɪ sɔ/
trPron: Dis izınt layk dı van ay so
collocations: isn't like, like the one
commonMistake: This is not similar to the one I saw. ✔️ (daha resmi)
aiExplain: Like burada "benzer" anlamında bir edattır. "Isn't like" doğru negatiftir.

en: That isn't typical of him.
ipa: /ðæt ˈɪzənt ˈtɪpɪkəl əv hɪm/
trPron: Det izınt tipikıl ov him
collocations: isn't typical of, typical of
commonMistake: That isn't typical for him. ❌
aiExplain: Typical of doğru kullanımdır. "Typical for" yanlıştır.

en: They aren't any different from us.
ipa: /ðeɪ ɑrnt ˈɛni ˈdɪfərənt frʌm ʌs/
trPron: Dey arnt eni difırınt fıram as
collocations: aren't different from, different from
commonMistake: They aren't any different than us. ❌ (Amerikan)
aiExplain: Standart İngilizcede "different from" doğrudur. "Different than" Amerikan İngilizcesidir.
imgQuery: group of diverse people standing together

en: It isn't worth waiting for.
ipa: /ɪt ˈɪzənt wɜrθ ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr/
trPron: İt izınt vörth veytİng for
collocations: isn't worth, worth waiting
commonMistake: It isn't worth waiting. ❌ (anlam değişir)
aiExplain: Worth den sonra -ing gelir. "Worth waiting for" beklemeye değer, "worth waiting" farklı anlamdadır.

grammar: Subject + is + not + at all + adjective
en: The food is not hot at all.
ipa: /ðə fuːd ɪz nɑt hɑt æt ɔl/
trPron: Dı fud iz nat hat et ol
collocations: not hot at all, at all hot
commonMistake: The food is not at all hot. ✔️ (doğru da)
aiExplain: Not at all genellikle sıfattan sonra gelir ama önce de gelebilir. Her ikisi de doğrudur.

en: The report isn't due until Friday.
tr: Raporun teslim tarihi Cuma'ya kadar değil.
ipa: /ðə rɪˈpɔrt ˈɪzənt du ənˈtɪl ˈfraɪdeɪ/
trPron: Dı riport izınt du antil fraydey
collocations: isn't due until, due until
commonMistake: The report isn't due Friday. ❌ (anlam değişir)
aiExplain: Until zaman aralığı belirtir. "Due Friday" Cuma günü teslim anlamına gelir, farklıdır.

en: I am not responsible for the loss.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt rɪˈspɑnsəbəl fɔr ðə lɔs/
trPron: Ay em nat rispansıbıl for dı los
collocations: not responsible for, responsible for
commonMistake: I am not responsible from the loss. ❌ (Türk hatası)
aiExplain: Responsible for doğru kullanımdır. "Responsible from" yanlıştır.

grammar: Subject + am not + about to + verb
en: I am not about to give up now.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt əˈbaʊt tu gɪv ʌp naʊ/
trPron: Ay em nat abaut tu giv ap nau
collocations: not about to, about to give
commonMistake: I am not about give up. ❌
aiExplain: About to kalıbında "to" şarttır. "About give up" yanlıştır.

grammar: Subject + am not + used to + gerund
en: I am not used to waking up early.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt just tu ˈweɪkɪŋ ʌp ˈɜrli/
trPron: Ay em nat yust tu veykİng ap örli
collocations: not used to, used to waking
commonMistake: I am not used waking up early. ❌
aiExplain: Used to kalıbında "to" bir edattır ve ardından isim/gerund gelir. "Used wake" yanlıştır.

grammar: Subject + am not + capable of + gerund
en: I am not capable of doing that.
ipa: /aɪ æm nɑt ˈkeɪpəbəl əv ˈduɪŋ ðæt/
trPron: Ay em nat keypıbıl ov duİng det
collocations: not capable of, capable of doing
commonMistake: I am not capable doing that. ❌
aiExplain: Capable of kalıbında "of" şarttır. "Capable doing" yanlıştır.
